description: Angular component for a Quick Links widget in the Thingsboard UI, managing user quick links, responsive layout, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: QuickLinksWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing user quick links with responsive layout and dialog interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets layout based on breakpoints, and loads quick links.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: menuLinks$
methods.description: Returns an observable of menu sections based on current quick links.

methods.name: loadQuickLinks
methods.description: Fetches quick links from user settings or defaults based on user authority.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit quick links and reloads links after dialog closes.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new quick link and updates user settings.
